purpose: Test a fixed training-free controller target-memory compiler and state-blind bounded control on two INDEPENDENT previously untested ManiSkill task/checkpoint families, without tuning on observed outcomes.

common_design.stateless_control: same decoder, rotation transform, bounded projection and source policy; ONLY previous target pose is replaced with achieved target EE pose
common_design.random_state_prospective_split: four eight-seed chunks per task, exact ascending integers, full 32 denominator; no omissions or replacements
common_design.success_definition: official ManiSkill info.success ever true during initial <=50 environment steps

exclusion: No adaptation code, model weights, action scaling, projection threshold or policy architecture may be changed after outcome inspection; any compatibility failure is a disclosed negative feasibility result.
limits: Third-party checkpoints evaluated by contributor in PhysX simulation; not real hardware, not external acceptance/adoption, no safety guarantee, no VLA or general method breakthrough without wider baseline comparison.
